datasets_waiting_for_real_data.reason: Census catalogue yielded no downloadable study-area table. WorldPop region statistics API returned a real GCC total, but its one-geometry-per-task ward API stalled after three ward responses; incomplete ward coverage cannot produce a population raster.
No downloadable official study-area table was obtained; WorldPop fallback was incomplete and therefore not processed.

acquired_climate.method: Nearest real source point mapped to the common grid; source model is much coarser than 30 m.

acquired_air_quality.method: Nearest real CAMS/Open-Meteo source point mapped to the common grid; not CPCB station data.

processing_notes.ndvi: Landsat Collection 2 SR_B5 and SR_B4 converted with scale 0.0000275 and offset -0.2, then (NIR-red)/(NIR+red); nonpositive reflectance masked.
processing_notes.ndbi: Landsat Collection 2 SR_B6 and SR_B5 converted with scale 0.0000275 and offset -0.2, then (SWIR-NIR)/(SWIR+NIR); nonpositive reflectance masked.
processing_notes.lst: Landsat ST_B10 scaled by 0.00341802 plus 149 Kelvin, converted to Celsius, with QA_PIXEL cloud masking.
processing_notes.thermal_exposure: LST normalized to 0-100 using the 2nd and 98th percentiles; higher values indicate higher thermal exposure.
processing_notes.lulc_alignment: ESA WorldCover categorical classes resampled nearest-neighbour to the common grid.
